title: רב חמא מנהדרעא

paragraphs: Rav Chama of Nehardea, in Rav Pappa's time, was head of the academy at Nehardea for fifteen years after Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak's death. See part 1, year 4117. “The amoraim of Nehardea”: Sanhedrin, end of chapter 1, 17b; Tosafot, Bava Batra 7b. Rav Pappa said to him: Ketubot 86a.
